text: Called PAWL-013 'delivered, immutable' when its status line says DRAFTED, NOT BUILT and the index agrees. Immutability binds delivered specs, so PAWL-013 could have been amended in place and superseding it is a choice rather than an obligation. PAWL-024 and PAWL-027 assert the same thing and are equally wrong — I inherited the error rather than inventing it, and correcting those is not this spec's to do
